requirements.text: Match only the same key and revision with equal scalar value.
Suppress duplicate sides and surface conflicting duplicate payloads.
Keep missing or mismatched counterparts visible with explicit late-arrival policy.

problem.scope: Authored scalar left/right records share an entity key and revision. Compare online keyed matching with immutable batch joins. This is not settlement, financial accounting or compliance.
